breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both periodic and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The agent's generated specification also correctly removed the contradictory Dirichlet condition, only stating that the domain has 'periodic boundary conditions', which aligns with the ground truth.
